pages.text: Lots of O-Animals group together naturally. Wild O-Horses spawn as family bands with one shared breed and coordinated ages. This also means you can easily corral a group of cows, for example, without having to use a billion leads.
O-Horses can move other animals while being ridden. These animals include Cows, Sheep, and Wild O-Horses. These animals will naturally run from your horse, so you can corral them into your pens.
